method.note: Leave-one-family-out ablation with surviving weights renormalized; strict walk-forward history. Historical evidence is descriptive, not proof of lottery predictability.

archive300.note: Longer archive is mixed. Removing FM slightly improves overall mean hits but weakens some of the strong full-model 4+/5+ cases. Pure top-22 slightly improves mean hits/p4+ but lowers p5+ relative to flex.

standalone.warning: Standalone overdue ranking is not a robust global predictor; its value appears as a nonlinear rescue overlay in the full model.

prospective_76_78.draw76: All ablations still captured 6/6. Winners were already high-ranked in PS/FM/ensemble; overdue was not responsible.
prospective_76_78.draw77: All main variants captured only 3/6. No component rescue was evident.
prospective_76_78.draw78: Full model captured 5/6; removing overdue fell to 3/6, while drop-smooth fell to 4/6. Overdue promoted #3 and #24 into the selected set.

interpretation: FM is the strongest standalone ranking family in the recent/prior window, but its long-run incremental value is not stable enough to upweight.
Persistence/PS is not spectacular standalone, but removing it disproportionately damages high-hit tail events.
Smooth is a stabilizer, especially in some rare-hit cases, but not a dominant standalone driver.
Overdue is best interpreted as tail insurance rather than a standalone predictor. It was decisive in draw 78, but globally is weak on its own.
The two-draw repeat/flex overlay sacrifices some long-run average-hit efficiency in the archive but improves recent performance and tends to protect p5+ tail capture.

decision.next_research: Only if further work is desired: raw FM subfeature attribution (recent z, long z, trend, repeat persistence, directional adjacency, same-draw clustering). No production tuning before prospective evidence accumulates.
